model.features: every rating, potential, last year's growth, level and value
model.calibration: one model set per league: DEV priced with this league's engine calibration (DEV engine price tag 608cdff64c-TGS); score only this league

definitions.players: keyed by player ID; every player of the league's latest pull aged 16-38 with a scoring row
definitions.r: role the models scored him in: H (hitter) or P (pitcher: pos SP, RP or CL)
definitions.now: his current WAA the models start from (neutral park): hitters Max WAA wtd, pitchers the larger of WAA wtd and WAA wtd RP; the same number dev_signals.json calls share_now
definitions.in_org: 1 = under contract with an org (not AMA, FA or INT)
definitions.gain: ages 16-26: eventual peak WAA minus now, quantiles 10/25/50/75/90, never below 0 and never crossing; Exp peak = now + gain[2], its range now + gain[1] to now + gain[3]
definitions.mlb: ages 16-26: chance his eventual peak reaches -1 WAA (an MLB-level player); 1 when now is at the bar (within 0.05)
definitions.useful: the same at 0 WAA (an average MLB player); never above mlb
definitions.good: the same at +1.5 WAA (a clear regular); never above useful
definitions.regular: ages 16-26: chance of some later MLB season with 300+ PA or 150+ BF (the app's Make it %)
definitions.d: ages 16-38: median change of his WAA 1..5 game-years from now (for a player still in the league)
definitions.dm: ages 16-38: expected (mean) change of his WAA 1..5 game-years from now, for money (FA pricing)
definitions.present1: ages 27-38: chance he is still in the league next season
definitions.note: 'ML, outside training range' when the models never saw players like him (app Lev INT: DEV has no unsigned international amateurs); left out otherwise
